text: Reconstructed from file timestamps after the fact: times before 21:30 are approximate.
Started exploring Television (telepath-computer/television) and whether it can run without a Mac.
Built a static PoC of Television's UI from its open specs (television-poc/).
Television's agent side is unsupported on Windows; WSL isn't installed here. The browser client works anywhere.
The filesystem is the API: channels are folders, artifacts are files, focus is a file (ADR 0001, 0004).
Core server + live UI running at localhost:4180; first agent-written artifact (json-render-app overview).
A repo view's scrollIntoView scrolled the whole stage sideways. Stage is now overflow: clip.
Two-way writes are limited to data files inside the artifact, with a custom header and origin check (ADR 0006).
Themes are one CSS file of design tokens; defaults sit in :where() so any theme wins (ADR 0005).
Eight themes, including animated Matrix, Final Fantasy, Azeroth and Synthwave backgrounds.
Project channels: this project and the Checkmate sample, each with dashboard, board, roadmap, ADRs.
Theme background iframe painted white under dark themes: its color-scheme must match the page.
Ideas page: how this becomes a real thing (directions, 16 features, 90-day plan, naming).
Sessions: one append-only .session.jsonl per day per project, kept by the CLI and Claude Code hooks.
Renamed the project from tv to Grimoire: .grimoire/ workspace, grim command, window.grim page API. Television stays credited.
Sessions shipped: daily .session.jsonl logs, grim CLI, Claude Code hooks (start/edit/stop/end), Sessions viewer with notes, dashboard panel.
Ideas page linked into the channel; naming journey recorded there (Glance → Tome → Grimoire).
Decide direction (OSS tool vs agent-native PM vs team hosting) after two weeks of dogfooding.
